label_text: Publication count (full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications affiliated with an institution, counted in full. Each publication is counted as one, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions.

label_text: Publication output share (full counting)
definition_short: The share of publication output represented by the selected subset, based on full-count publications.
definition_long: The selected subset's full-count publications divided by the full-count total in the same reference context, for example across displayed subject categories.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as a compositional share: across a complete partition, shares sum to one.

label_text: Publication count (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of publications of an institution, counted fractionally. Each publication is weighted by the inverse of the number of co-affiliated institutions.

label_text: Total citation score (TCS) (fractional counting)
definition_short: The total number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Recent-year declines are structurally expected because newer publications have had less time to accumulate citations.

label_text: Total citation score (TCS) (full counting)
definition_short: The total number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Recent-year declines are structurally expected because newer publications have had less time to accumulate citations.

label_text: Mean citation score (MCS) (fractional counting)
definition_short: The average number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Late-period values are structurally lower because recent publications have shorter citation windows.

label_text: Mean citation score (MCS) (full counting)
definition_short: The average number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Late-period values are structurally lower because recent publications have shorter citation windows.

label_text: Median citation score (MedCS) (fractional counting)
definition_short: The median number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Late-period values are structurally lower because recent publications have shorter citation windows.

label_text: Median citation score (MedCS) (full counting)
definition_short: The median number of citations received by an institution's publications, irrespectively of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Late-period values are structurally lower because recent publications have shorter citation windows.

label_text: Mean normalised citation score (MNCS) (fractional counting)
definition_short: The mean citation impact of an institution's publications, normalised by research field, publication year and publication type. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret single-year changes cautiously and prioritize sustained multi-year movement; this normalized indicator is intended for cross-field comparison.

label_text: Mean normalised citation score (MNCS) (full counting)
definition_short: The mean citation impact of an institution's publications, normalised by research field, publication year and publication type, independent of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret single-year changes cautiously and prioritize sustained multi-year movement; this normalized indicator is intended for cross-field comparison.

label_text: Publications in the top 10\% most-cited (Ptop 10\%, fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of publications affiliated with an institution (fractional counting) that belongs to the 10\% most frequently cited publications, relative to other publications in the same research field, publication year and publication type. Each publication is weighted by the inverse of the number of co-affiliated institutions. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Percentile-based impact can fluctuate in small yearly cohorts, so prioritize sustained multi-year patterns.

label_text: Publications in the top 10\% most-cited (Ptop 10\%, full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications affiliated with an institution that belongs to the 10\% most frequently cited publications, relative to other publications in the same research field, publication year and publication type. Each qualifying publication is counted as one. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Percentile-based impact can fluctuate in small yearly cohorts, so prioritize sustained multi-year patterns.

label_text: Proportion of publications in the top 10\% most-cited (PPtop 10\%, fractional counting)
definition_short: The proportion of an institution's total publication output that belongs to the top 10\% most-cited publications in the same research field, publication year and publication type. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Percentile-based impact can fluctuate in small yearly cohorts, so prioritize sustained multi-year patterns; interpret together with publication volume.

label_text: Share of publications in the top 10\% most-cited (PPtop 10\%, full counting)
definition_short: The share of an institution's total publication output that belongs to the top 10\% most-cited publications in the same research field, publication year and publication type. Both the top 10\% output and the total output are calculated using full counting, where each publication is counted as one.
interpretation_advice: Percentile-based impact can fluctuate in small yearly cohorts, so prioritize sustained multi-year patterns and interpret together with publication volume.

label_text: Uncited publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of an institution's publications with zero citations, restricted to reliable citation cohorts, computed using full counting.
definition_long: Number of publications in the analysis window that have zero recorded citations and belongs to citation cohorts with sufficient size for reliable normalization (cohort\_is\_reliable = TRUE), using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Recent-year values are structurally higher because citations accumulate over time.

label_text: Proportion of uncited publications (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of an institution's publications with zero citations, restricted to reliable citation cohorts, computed using full counting.
definition_long: Proportion of publications in the analysis window that have zero recorded citations and belongs to citation cohorts with sufficient size for reliable normalization (cohort\_is\_reliable = TRUE), using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Recent-year values are structurally higher because citations accumulate over time.

label_text: Self-citations (number of self-citing works, full counting)
definition_short: The number of incoming citations that are self-citations, where the citing and cited works share at least one author, computed using full counting.
definition_long: Number of distinct citing works per cited work that share at least one author with the cited work, summed across the institution's publications in the analysis window, using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret alongside total citations because the count scales with publication volume.

label_text: Proportion of self-citations (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations that are self-citations, where the citing and cited works share at least one author, computed using full counting.
definition_long: Ratio of self-citing works to all citing works across the institution's publications in the analysis window, using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret alongside total citations and field mix; self-citation propensities can vary structurally across disciplines.

label_text: Citation volume by citing institution (full counting)
definition_short: The number of citations to publications of the institution under evaluation by the citing institution, using full counting on the citing side.
definition_long: Each citation link to the evaluated institution's publications is allocated in full to every institution represented on the citing publication.

label_text: Citing institutions (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of citations to publications of the institution under evaluation by the citing institution, using fractional counting on the citing side.

label_text: Citation volume by Swiss citing institution (full counting)
definition_short: The number of citations to publications of the institution under evaluation by the citing institution located in Switzerland, using full counting on the citing side.
definition_long: Each citation link to the evaluated institution's publications is allocated in full to every Swiss institution represented on the citing publication.

label_text: National citing institutions (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of citations by a citing institution located in Switzerland, using fractional counting.

label_text: International citing institutions (full counting)
definition_short: The number of citations by a citing institution located outside Switzerland, using full counting.

label_text: International citing institutions (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of citations by a citing institution located outside Switzerland, using fractional counting.

label_text: Citing countries
definition_short: The number of citations to publications of the institution under evaluation by the country of the citing institutions, using full counting on the citing side.
definition_long: Each citation link to the evaluated institution's publications is allocated in full to every country represented on the citing publication.

label_text: Proportion of incoming citation links by citing institution (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations in which the citing institution is represented.
definition_long: Each institution-level full-count citing volume is divided by the evaluated institution's total incoming citation links over the same period, before expansion to citing institutions. Shares are therefore non-exclusive across institutions.
interpretation_advice: Shares are non-exclusive across institutions and can sum to more than 100\% because a single citing publication can involve multiple institutions.

label_text: Proportion of incoming citation links by citing institution (fractional counting)
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations attributed to each citing institution after fractional allocation across citing institutions.
definition_long: Each institution-level fractional citing volume is divided by the evaluated institution's full-counted total incoming citation links (P\lbrackall cits\rbrack_full) over the same period.
interpretation_advice: Values use a fractional numerator based on citing-side institutions and a full-count denominator, so they are comparable to the full-count share.

label_text: Share of incoming citation links by Swiss citing institution (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations in which the Swiss citing institution is represented.
definition_long: Each Swiss institution-level full-count citing volume is divided by the evaluated institution's total incoming citation links over the same period, before expansion to citing institutions. The denominator is the same as for the overall citing-institution table.
interpretation_advice: Shares are non-exclusive across Swiss institutions and can sum to more than 100\% because a single citing publication can involve multiple Swiss institutions.

label_text: Fractional share of incoming citation links by Swiss citing institution
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations attributed to each Swiss citing institution after fractional allocation across citing institutions.
definition_long: Each Swiss institution-level fractional citing volume is divided by the evaluated institution's full-counted total incoming citation links over the same period.
interpretation_advice: Values use a fractional numerator based on all citing-side institutions and a full-count denominator, so Swiss shares are not renormalized to Swiss-only citing institutions.

label_text: Share of incoming citation links by citing country
definition_short: The proportion of incoming citations in which the citing country is represented.
definition_long: Each country-level full-count citing volume is divided by the evaluated institution's total incoming citation links over the same period, before expansion to citing countries. Shares are therefore non-exclusive across countries.
interpretation_advice: Shares are non-exclusive across countries and can sum to more than 100\% because a single citing publication can involve multiple countries.

label_text: World share of citation links by citing institution
definition_short: The proportion of global citations in which the citing institution is represented.
definition_long: Each institution-level full-count global citing volume is divided by the total number of global outgoing citation links to publications from the evaluation period, before expansion to citing institutions. The same global benchmark is used for overall and national citing-institution overrepresentation tables.
interpretation_advice: Shares are non-exclusive across institutions because a single citing publication can involve multiple institutions.

label_text: Relative citation presence by citing institution
definition_short: The ratio between the evaluated institution’s share of citations from a citing institution and the citing institution’s share of global citations. Values above 1 indicate that the citing institution is overrepresented among citations to the evaluated institution, while values below 1 indicate underrepresentation.
definition_long: Computed as PC\lbrackinst\rbrack divided by PC\lbrackworld\rbrack for the corresponding citing institution. Values above 1 indicate that the citing institution is represented more strongly among incoming citations to the evaluated institution than in global citation activity.
interpretation_advice: Values above 1 indicate above-benchmark citation uptake, values below 1 indicate below-benchmark uptake.

label_text: World share of citation links by citing country
definition_short: The proportion of global citations attributable to citing institutions located in the citing country.
definition_long: Each country-level full-count global citing volume is divided by the total number of global outgoing citation links to publications from the evaluation period, before expansion to citing countries.
interpretation_advice: Shares are non-exclusive across countries because a single citing publication can involve institutions from multiple countries.

label_text: Relative citation presence by citing country
definition_short: The ratio between the evaluated institution's share of citations from the citing country and that country's share of global citations. Values above 1 indicate that the citing country is overrepresented among citations to the evaluated institution, while values below 1 indicate underrepresentation.
definition_long: Computed as PC\lbrackcountry\rbrack divided by PC\lbrackworld\rbrack for the corresponding citing country. Values above 1 indicate that the citing country is represented more strongly among incoming citations to the evaluated institution than in global citation activity.
interpretation_advice: Values above 1 indicate above-benchmark citation uptake, values below 1 indicate below-benchmark uptake.

label_text: Patent-cited publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of an institution's publications that are cited by at least one patent, counted in full.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Patent-cited publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of an institution's publications that are cited by at least one patent, counted fractionally by co-affiliated institutions.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Share of patent-cited publications (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of an institution's publications that are cited by at least one patent, computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Share of patent-cited publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The proportion of an institution's publications that are cited by at least one patent, computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Year-normalised share of patent-cited publications (full counting)
definition_short: The institution's yearly share of patent-cited publications, normalised by the dataset-wide average share for the same year, computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Year-normalised share of patent-cited publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The institution's yearly share of patent-cited publications, normalised by the dataset-wide average share for the same year, computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Patent-citation indicators have long lags, so recent publication years are expected to be lower.

label_text: Share of collaboration output by partner institution (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner institution over the full analysis period, using fractional counting.
definition_long: For each partner institution, collaborative output is measured as the sum of fractionally counted co-authored publications across the full analysis period. The indicator is the partner's share of the institution's total collaborative publication volume under the same counting method.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as relative collaboration intensity by partner institution within the institution's collaboration portfolio.

label_text: Recent share of collaboration output by partner institution (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner institution during the recent comparison period, using fractional counting.
definition_long: For each partner institution, collaborative output is measured as the sum of fractionally counted co-authored publications in the recent comparison period. The indicator is the partner's share of the institution's total collaborative publication volume in that same period.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as relative recent collaboration intensity by partner institution within the institution's collaboration portfolio.

label_text: Baseline share of collaboration output by partner institution (fractional counting)

definition_long: For each partner institution, collaborative output is measured as the sum of fractionally counted co-authored publications in the baseline comparison period. The indicator is the partner's share of the institution's total collaborative publication volume in that same period.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as relative baseline collaboration intensity by partner institution within the institution's collaboration portfolio.

label_text: Collaboration impact by partner (MNCS) (fractional counting)
definition_short: The mean normalised citation score (MNCS) of collaborative publications with a partner institution. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with collaboration volume and minimum publication thresholds, because small partner-level cohorts can be unstable.

label_text: Collaboration impact by partner (MNCS) (full counting)
definition_short: The mean normalised citation score (MNCS) of collaborative publications with a partner institution. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with collaboration volume and minimum publication thresholds, because small partner-level cohorts can be unstable.

interpretation_advice: Interpret together with collaboration volume and minimum publication thresholds, because small partner-level cohorts can be unstable.

label_text: Proportion of affiliated authors by inferred gender
definition_short: The proportion of unique authors on the institution's publications, by inferred gender, among those inferred as male or female.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

label_text: Proportion of all contributing authors by inferred gender
definition_short: The proportion of unique authors contributing to the institution's publications, regardless of affiliation, among those inferred as male or female.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

label_text: Relative representation of female affiliated authors
definition_short: The ratio of the proportion of female authors among affiliated authors to the proportion of female authors among all contributing authors on the institution's publications. Values above 1 indicate overrepresentation of female affiliated authors, while values below 1 indicate underrepresentation.
definition_long: Ratio of the affiliated female-author share to the overall female-author share among authors inferred as female or male.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; this indicator is descriptive rather than evaluative.

subdomain: Average number of authors by gender
label_text: Average number of affiliated authors by gender per publication
definition_short: The average number of affiliated authors per publication of the institution, by inferred gender (male, female, unknown).
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

subdomain: Average number of authors by gender
label_text: Average number of affiliated authors by gender per publication and year
definition_short: The average number of affiliated authors per publication of the institution, by inferred gender (male, female, unknown) by year.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

subdomain: Average number of authors by gender
label_text: Average number of all contributing authors by gender per publication
definition_short: The average number of all contributing authors (independent of affiliation) per publication of the institution, reported by inferred gender (male, female, unknown).
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

subdomain: Average number of authors by gender
label_text: Average number of all contributing authors by gender per publication and year
definition_short: The average number of all contributing authors (independent of affiliation) per publication of the institution, reported by inferred gender (male, female, unknown) by year.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can misclassify and has unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously; these indicators are descriptive rather than evaluative.

subdomain: Average number of authors per publication
label_text: Average number of affiliated authors per publication
definition_short: The average number of affiliated authors per publication, including female, male and unknown gender categories.
interpretation_advice: This indicator is descriptive and depends on author disambiguation and affiliation assignment.

subdomain: Average number of authors per publication
label_text: Average number of female affiliated authors per publication
definition_short: The average number of affiliated authors inferred as female per publication.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Author-weighted female proportion among gender-inferred affiliated authors per publication
definition_short: The author-weighted proportion of female authors among the institution's affiliated authors with inferred gender, with publications weighted by the number of gender-inferred affiliated author appearances.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Average publication-level female proportion among affiliated authors
definition_short: The average publication-level proportion of female authors among the institution's affiliated authors with inferred gender, with each publication weighted equally.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

subdomain: Average number of authors per publication
label_text: Average number of contributing authors per publication
definition_short: The average number of all contributing authors per publication, regardless of institutional affiliation and including female, male and unknown gender categories.
interpretation_advice: This indicator is descriptive and depends on author disambiguation.

subdomain: Average number of authors per publication
label_text: Average number of female contributing authors per publication
definition_short: The average number of all contributing authors inferred as female per publication, regardless of institutional affiliation.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Author-weighted female proportion among gender-inferred contributing authors per publication
definition_short: The author-weighted proportion of female authors among all contributing authors with inferred gender, with publications weighted by the number of gender-inferred contributing author appearances.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Average publication-level female proportion among contributing authors
definition_short: The average publication-level proportion of female authors among all contributing authors with inferred gender, with each publication weighted equally.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Relative representation of female affiliated authors per publication
definition_short: The ratio of the author-weighted proportion of female authors among the institution's affiliated authors to the author-weighted proportion of female authors among all contributing authors (excluding authors with unknown gender).
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Relative representation based on average publication-level female shares
definition_short: The ratio of the average publication-level proportion of female authors among the institution's affiliated authors to the average publication-level proportion of female authors among all contributing authors (excluding authors with unknown gender), with each publication weighted equally.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Submitted works (all years)
definition_short: The number of publication records submitted by the institution across all years.
definition_long: Total number of publication records delivered by the institution before any year-window filtering, matching, deduplication and scope filtering.
interpretation_advice: This is a data coverage metric and should not be interpreted as research performance.

label_text: Works found in OpenAlex
definition_short: The number of submitted records matched to OpenAlex.
definition_long: Number of submitted publication records linked to an OpenAlex work record before deduplication.
interpretation_advice: This is a data coverage metric and should not be interpreted as research performance.

label_text: Unique works
definition_short: The number of matched works after deduplication.
definition_long: Number of distinct OpenAlex works retained after duplicate matches are removed.
interpretation_advice: This is a data coverage metric and should not be interpreted as research performance.

label_text: In-scope works
definition_short: The number of unique works meeting all scope criteria (English language, authorship metadata, subfield assignment, referenced works, core/proceedings outlet, not retracted, not paratext).
definition_long: Number of unique works that satisfy all inclusion criteria used to define the scoped publication set for indicator production.
interpretation_advice: This is a data coverage metric and should not be interpreted as research performance.

label_text: Works in evaluation period
definition_short: The number of submitted records retained in the evaluation-period step of the coverage funnel.
definition_long: Number of submitted records retained after excluding records matched to publication years outside the report's defined evaluation window.
interpretation_advice: This is a data coverage metric and should not be interpreted as research performance.

label_text: Number of internationally collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution outside Switzerland. Computed using full counting.

label_text: Proportion of internationally collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of publications with at least one collaborating institution outside Switzerland. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with publication volume, because shares can fluctuate in smaller yearly cohorts.

label_text: Number of internationally collaborative publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution outside Switzerland, computed using fractional counting across affiliated institutions.

label_text: Share of internationally collaborative publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The proportion of publications co-authored with at least one collaborating institution outside Switzerland relative to the total publication output. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with fractional publication volume, because shares can fluctuate in smaller yearly cohorts.

label_text: Industry-collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution classified as industry/company. Computed using full counting.

label_text: Proportion of industry-collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of publications with at least one collaborating institution classified as industry/company. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with publication volume and field mix, because collaboration profiles can differ structurally across domains.

label_text: Collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution. Computed using full counting.

label_text: Collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution. Computed using full counting.

label_text: Proportion of collaborative publications (full counting)
definition_short: The proportion of publications with at least one collaborating institution. Computed using full counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with publication volume, because shares can fluctuate in smaller yearly cohorts.

label_text: Collaborative publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of publications with at least one collaborating institution, computed using fractional counting across affiliated institutions.

label_text: Share of collaborative publications (fractional counting)
definition_short: The proportion of publications co-authored with at least one collaborating institution relative to the total publication output. Computed using fractional counting.
interpretation_advice: Interpret together with fractional publication volume, because shares can fluctuate in smaller yearly cohorts.

label_text: Recent international collaboration volume by country (full counting)
definition_short: The number of internationally collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the recent comparison period, using full counting.

label_text: Baseline international collaboration volume by country (full counting)
definition_short: The number of internationally collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, using full counting.

label_text: Recent share of international collaboration volume by country (full counting)
definition_short: The share of internationally collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the recent comparison period, using full counting.

label_text: Baseline share of international collaboration volume by country (full counting)
definition_short: The share of internationally collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, using full counting.

label_text: Change in international collaboration share by country (full counting)
definition_short: The difference in country-level share of international collaboration volume between the recent and baseline comparison periods, using full counting, expressed in percentage points.

label_text: Recent international collaboration volume by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of internationally collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the recent comparison period, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Baseline international collaboration volume by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of internationally collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Recent share of international collaboration volume by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of internationally collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the recent comparison period, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Baseline share of international collaboration volume by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of internationally collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Change in international collaboration share by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The difference in country-level share of international collaboration volume between the recent and baseline comparison periods, using fractional counting, expressed in percentage points.

label_text: Recent collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: The number of collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the recent comparison period, including Switzerland, using full counting.

label_text: Baseline collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: The number of collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, including Switzerland, using full counting.

label_text: Recent share of total output involving a partner country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: For each partner country, the indicator equals the fully counted number of collaborative publications involving at least one institution in that country during the recent comparison period divided by the institution's total publication output during the same period.

label_text: Baseline share of total output involving a partner country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: For each partner country, the indicator equals the fully counted number of collaborative publications involving at least one institution in that country during the baseline comparison period divided by the institution's total publication output during the same period.

label_text: Change in total output share involving a partner country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: The difference between the recent and baseline shares of the institution's total publication output involving each partner country, including Switzerland, using full counting, expressed in percentage points.

label_text: Share of total output involving a partner country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: For each partner country, the indicator equals the fully counted number of collaborative publications involving at least one institution in that country divided by the institution's total publication output in the same scope over the full analysis period.
definition_long: Shares are non-exclusive and do not sum to 100\% across countries.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as the share of the institution's total output that involves the country.

label_text: Change in total output share involving a partner country incl. Switzerland (full counting)
definition_short: The difference between the recent and baseline shares of the institution's total publication output involving each partner country, including Switzerland, using full counting, expressed in percentage points.
definition_long: The recent period spans the last moving-average window (typically 4 years) and the baseline period covers all earlier years in the analysis window. Shares are computed against the institution's total publication output in each period under the same scope and counting method.
interpretation_advice: Positive values mean a higher recent share vs. baseline and negative values mean a lower recent share.

label_text: Recent collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the recent comparison period, including Switzerland, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Baseline collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (fractional counting)
definition_short: The number of collaborative publications linked to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, including Switzerland, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Recent share of collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the recent comparison period, including Switzerland, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Baseline share of collaboration volume by country incl. Switzerland (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of collaborative publication volume attributed to each partner country during the baseline comparison period, including Switzerland, using fractional counting across partner countries.

label_text: Change in collaboration share by country incl. Switzerland (fractional counting)
definition_short: The difference in country-level collaboration share between the recent and baseline comparison periods, including Switzerland, using fractional counting, expressed in percentage points.

label_text: Share of outside-ETH-Domain collaboration output by country (fractional counting)
definition_short: The share of ETH Domain outside-ETH-Domain collaborative output attributed to each partner country over the full analysis period, using deduplicated fractional counting.
definition_long: For each country, collaborative output is measured as the sum of deduplicated fractional external collaboration links attributed to institutions in that country, aggregated across the full analysis period. The indicator is the country's share of the total across all outside-ETH-Domain countries under the same definition.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as relative collaboration intensity by country within the ETH Domain outside-partner country portfolio.

label_text: Change in outside-ETH-Domain country collaboration share (fractional counting)
definition_short: The change in each partner country's share of outside-ETH-Domain collaborative output between the recent and baseline periods, using deduplicated fractional counting, expressed in percentage points.
definition_long: The recent period spans the last moving-average window (typically 4 years) and the baseline period covers all earlier years in the analysis window. The indicator equals (recent share - baseline share) x 100 percentage points.
interpretation_advice: Positive values mean a higher recent share vs. baseline and negative values mean a lower recent share.

label_text: Share of total output involving a partner country outside the ETH Domain (full counting)
definition_short: For each partner country, the indicator equals the fully counted number of collaborative publications involving at least one institution in that country outside the ETH Domain divided by the institution's total publication output over the full analysis period.
definition_long: Shares are non-exclusive and do not sum to 100\% across countries.
interpretation_advice: Interpret as the share of total output that involves the country outside the ETH Domain.

label_text: Change in total output share involving a partner country outside the ETH Domain (full counting)
definition_short: The difference between the recent and baseline shares of the institution's total publication output involving each partner country outside the ETH Domain, using full counting, expressed in percentage points.
definition_long: The recent period spans the last moving-average window (typically 4 years) and the baseline period covers all earlier years in the analysis window. Shares are computed against the institution's total publication output in each period under the same scope and counting method.
interpretation_advice: Positive values mean a higher recent share vs. baseline and negative values mean a lower recent share.

label_text: Incoming citation links by country (full counting)
definition_short: The number of incoming citing-work-to-country links attributed to each citing country, using full counting across countries on citing works.

label_text: Share of incoming citation links by country (full counting)
definition_short: The share of incoming citing-work-to-country links attributed to each citing country over the full analysis period, using full counting.

label_text: Incoming citation links by citing institution location (full counting)
definition_short: The number of incoming citing-work-to-institution links attributed to each citing institution location, using full counting.

label_text: Share of incoming citation links by citing institution location (full counting)
definition_short: The share of incoming citing-work-to-institution links attributed to each citing institution location over the full analysis period, using full counting.

label_text: Interdisciplinarity index (Rao-Stirling integration)
definition_short: The interdisciplinarity of publications, measured using Rao-Stirling diversity by the extent to which their references cite publications from distant subfields in the topic hierarchy.
definition_long: Computed in two stages. First, each work receives a Rao-Stirling integration score from the distribution of its references across cited subfields using hierarchy distances of 0 within the same subfield, 1/3 across subfields within a field, 2/3 across fields within a domain and 1 across domains. Table-level values aggregate work-level scores as a fractionally weighted mean across works with at least 5 references mapped to known subfields.
interpretation_advice: Higher values indicate that references span more distant parts of the topic hierarchy. Interpret cautiously for small sets because fewer qualifying works can make the indicator more volatile.

label_text: Specialisation index
definition_short: The specialisation index is the ratio of an institution's fractional publication-output share in a given field or subfield to that field's or subfield's share of global publication output. A value of 2 indicates that the field or subfield is represented twice as strongly in the institution's publication profile as in global publication output.
definition_long: The institution's fractional publication output in a field or subfield is divided by its total fractional publication output, then compared with the corresponding field or subfield share of global full-count publication output. Values above 1 indicate relative overrepresentation.
interpretation_advice: Values above 1 indicate that the field or subfield is represented more strongly in the institution's publication profile than in global publication output.

label_text: In-range coverage ratio
definition_short: The share of unique matched works that are included in the analysis period after scope filtering.
definition_long: Computed as COV_WORKS_IN_SCOPE divided by COV_WORKS_UNIQUE, both restricted to the evaluation period (matches the last bar of the coverage funnel chart).
interpretation_advice: This is a coverage quality metric and not a direct research performance metric.

label_text: All incoming citations (number of citing works, full counting)
definition_short: Total number of incoming citing works across the institution's publications, computed with full counting.
definition_long: Number of distinct citing works per cited work, summed across the institution's publication set.
interpretation_advice: Interpret alongside publication volume and field mix because totals scale strongly with size.

label_text: Proportion of female affiliated authors
definition_short: The proportion of female authors among the institution's affiliated authors with inferred gender.
definition_long: Female affiliated authors divided by affiliated authors inferred as female or male.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Proportion of male affiliated authors
definition_short: The proportion of male authors among the institution's affiliated authors with inferred gender.
definition_long: Male affiliated authors divided by affiliated authors inferred as female or male.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Proportion of male contributing authors
definition_short: The proportion of male authors among all contributing authors with inferred gender.
definition_long: Male contributing authors divided by all contributing authors inferred as female or male.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Proportion of female contributing authors
definition_short: The proportion of female authors among all contributing authors with inferred gender.
definition_long: Female contributing authors divided by all contributing authors inferred as female or male.
interpretation_advice: Name-based gender inference can carry unequal error rates across groups, so interpret differences cautiously.

label_text: Lower confidence bound of MNCS (fractional counting)

definition_long: Lower bound of the configured confidence interval for yearly or moving-average MNCS.
interpretation_advice: Treat as an uncertainty bound and interpret together with the point estimate and upper bound.

label_text: Upper confidence bound of MNCS (fractional counting)
definition_short: Upper bootstrap confidence bound for MNCS under fractional counting.
definition_long: Upper bound of the configured confidence interval for yearly or moving-average MNCS.
interpretation_advice: Treat as an uncertainty bound and interpret together with the point estimate and lower bound.

label_text: Lower confidence bound of PPtop10 (fractional counting)

interpretation_advice: Treat as an uncertainty bound and interpret together with the point estimate and upper bound.

label_text: Upper confidence bound of PPtop10 (fractional counting)
definition_short: Upper bootstrap confidence bound for PPtop10 under fractional counting.
definition_long: Upper bound of the configured confidence interval for yearly or moving-average PPtop10.

definition_long: Number of unique affiliated authors with inferred gender female.

definition_long: Number of unique contributing authors with inferred gender male.
